ENOTS (6-2, 3 FAAB) holds both Hall and Allen, so the Jets split is covered, but they can only improve by trade.
DiaperDutyDaddy (4-4, 2 FAAB) has Barkley limited, Monangai out and Pollard on bye, with no money to cover any of it.
pauldag (4-4, 93 FAAB) has WR trouble in Flowers, Brown and Downs, and has the money to act on it.
Stipe (5-3, 89 FAAB) needs the unrostered Lloyd as Jacobs insurance, while bwalsh89 (3-5, 64 FAAB) has Skattebo, Harvey and Tate all hurt.
